title: procedural_deadline.triggered payload (v1)
description: Wire payload of `procedural_deadline.triggered`. Records which governed source started which deadline, exactly once (Framework hard invariant 59). `source` can never be delivery_telemetry or read_telemetry. No field in this payload carries an identity attribute, a global person identifier, a party or authority handle, a document or its bytes, message content, an authentication secret, or any ballot/vote/tally/delegation reference (PACK-09 required invariants 1, 11, 12 and 13; Framework 0.8.1 section 11).
